# PhysxVehicleSuspensionAPI

Suspension parameters of a [PhysX](glossary.md#physx) vehicle, shareable between wheel attachments. The walkers parse every [prim](glossary.md#prim) that lists it. A wheel attachment uses the prim its physxVehicleWheelAttachment:suspension relationship targets (exactly one target), or itself when it lists this API.

- **Applies to:** [`Typed`](glossary.md#typed)
- **Read only when listed in [`usd-schemas`](prim.md#columns).**
- **No builder:** `ovphysx.population` and `Population.hpp` do not write this component; the consumer reads it when another population writes it.

## Notes

- Its columns are not described yet.
